title: 渦輪分子泵與真空計~Turbomolecular pumps and vacuum gauges
focus: 葉片動量傳遞、壓縮比與前級、轉子工程，以及從 1000 到 10⁻¹¹ mbar 的量測鏈~Blade momentum transfer, compression and backing, rotor engineering, and the measurement chain from 1000 to 10⁻¹¹ mbar
summary: 以一台 DN100、約 260 L/s 的混合軸承渦輪分子泵與它的泵站為對象：從分子流下葉片把動量傳給氣體分子出發，理解壓縮比為何隨分子量呈指數變化、前級壓力如何決定極限壓力；再把轉子材料與動平衡、電容薄膜計、Pirani、Penning 與 Bayard–Alpert 真空計的物理與校正鏈、抽速量測與互鎖整合成可驗收的真空泵站。~Built around a DN100, roughly 260 L/s hybrid-bearing turbomolecular pump and its pumping station: start from blades handing momentum to gas molecules in molecular flow to see why the compression ratio grows exponentially with molecular mass and how foreline pressure sets the ultimate pressure, then integrate rotor materials and balancing, the physics and calibration chain of capacitance-diaphragm, Pirani, Penning and Bayard–Alpert gauges, pumping-speed measurement and interlocks into a pumping station that can be accepted.

units.anchor: 轉子葉片與氣體分子~Rotor blades and gas molecules
units.title: 分子流下的葉片動量傳遞~Blade momentum transfer in molecular flow
units.mechanism: 在分子流中，撞上葉片表面的分子會以漫反射重新發射，並疊加上葉片表面的速度；當葉尖速度與分子熱速度 c̄ = √(8kT/πm) 同量級時，傾斜的葉片讓從入口側來的分子較容易被送到出口側、反向的分子較難穿透，單級形成一個方向性的傳輸機率差，數十級轉子與定子交替串聯後得到很高的壓縮比。因為 c̄ 隨 1/√M 增加，氫分子比氮快 3.7 倍，同一組葉片對氫的「追得上」程度差很多，壓縮比隨 √M 呈指數變化。入口的最大抽速則受限於入口截面與捕獲機率，與葉片轉得多快關係不大。~In molecular flow a molecule striking a blade is re-emitted diffusely with the blade's surface velocity added; when the blade-tip speed is comparable to the molecular thermal speed c̄ = √(8kT/πm), the inclined blades let molecules arriving from the inlet side pass to the outlet side more readily than the reverse, each stage producing a directional difference in transmission probability, and tens of alternating rotor and stator stages in series multiply into a very high compression ratio. Because c̄ grows as 1/√M, hydrogen moves 3.7 times faster than nitrogen, the blades keep up with it far less well, and the compression ratio therefore varies exponentially with √M. The maximum inlet pumping speed is bounded by the inlet cross-section and the capture probability and depends little on how fast the blades turn.
units.model: 轉子 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s、直徑 0.1 m，葉尖速度 v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s。氮在 293 K 的 c̄ = √(8×1.38×10⁻²³×293/(π×28×1.66×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 471 m/s，兩者相當；氫的 c̄ ≈ 471×√14 ≈ 1760 m/s，v/c̄ 只有 0.27。壓縮比寫成 K₀ ∝ exp(a·√M)：若純渦輪級對氮 K₀ = 10⁸，則 a·√28 = 18.4，a ≈ 3.48，對氫 K₀ ≈ exp(3.48×√2) ≈ 140（教學估算；實際混合泵靠 Holweck 段把氫壓縮比拉到 10³–10⁵）。入口抽速上限 S ≈ 11.6·A·α，DN100 入口 A ≈ 78.5 cm²，捕獲機率 α ≈ 0.3，S ≈ 273 L/s，與 DN100 泵約 260 L/s 的標稱值相符。~A rotor at 90,000 rpm = 1500 rev/s with 0.1 m diameter has a tip speed v = π·D·n ≈ 471 m/s. Nitrogen at 293 K has c̄ = √(8×1.38×10⁻²³×293/(π×28×1.66×10⁻²⁷)) ≈ 471 m/s, a match; hydrogen has c̄ ≈ 471×√14 ≈ 1760 m/s, so v/c̄ is only 0.27. Writing K₀ ∝ exp(a·√M): if pure turbo stages give K₀ = 10⁸ for nitrogen then a·√28 = 18.4, a ≈ 3.48 and K₀ ≈ exp(3.48×√2) ≈ 140 for hydrogen (teaching estimate; real hybrid pumps use Holweck stages to lift hydrogen compression to 10³–10⁵). The inlet speed limit S ≈ 11.6·A·α with A ≈ 78.5 cm² for DN100 and capture probability α ≈ 0.3 gives S ≈ 273 L/s, consistent with the roughly 260 L/s nameplate of a DN100 pump.
units.verify: 用流量計法分別對氮、氦與氫量抽速，確認三者只差百分之幾十，而壓縮比卻差數個數量級：把入口封死、從前級注入測試氣體，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，零流量時的比值就是 K₀；對氫要用入口的殘氣分析儀讀分壓，因為總壓計被氮當量主導。把量到的 K₀(N₂)、K₀(He)、K₀(H₂) 對 √M 作半對數圖，應近似一條直線。~Measure pumping speed by the flow-meter method separately for nitrogen, helium and hydrogen, confirming they differ by only tens of percent while the compression ratios differ by orders of magnitude: blank off the inlet, feed test gas into the foreline, log foreline and inlet pressure, and the zero-flow ratio is K₀; for hydrogen read the inlet partial pressure with a residual-gas analyser because the total-pressure gauge is dominated by the nitrogen equivalent. Plotting the measured K₀ for N₂, He and H₂ against √M on a semi-log scale should give roughly a straight line.
units.failure: 極限壓力被氫回流卡住：前級中氫分壓 10⁻⁴ mbar，若泵對氫的 K₀ 只有 10³，入口氫分壓就是 10⁻⁷ mbar，永遠進不了超高真空；症狀是入口殘氣譜的氫峰隨前級壓力同步起伏，換更大的渦輪泵也沒用，要改的是對氫的壓縮比或前級泵。~The ultimate pressure is pinned by hydrogen backflow: with a hydrogen partial pressure of 10⁻⁴ mbar in the foreline and a pump whose K₀ for hydrogen is only 10³, the inlet hydrogen partial pressure is 10⁻⁷ mbar and ultrahigh vacuum is never reached; the symptom is an inlet hydrogen peak that rises and falls in step with the foreline pressure, a bigger turbopump does not help, and what must change is the hydrogen compression or the backing pump.
units.misconception: 渦輪泵對所有氣體的壓縮比都一樣。~A turbopump compresses every gas by the same ratio.

units.anchor: 前級管路與 Holweck 段~Foreline and Holweck stage
units.title: 壓縮比、前級壓力與極限壓力~Compression ratio, foreline pressure and ultimate pressure
units.mechanism: 渦輪級只在分子流下工作，入口壓力高於約 10⁻² mbar 時葉片間的分子互撞使壓縮失效，所以渦輪泵一定需要前級泵。混合泵在渦輪級之後加上 Holweck 螺旋槽拖曳段，把容許的前級壓力拉高到數 mbar，因此能用隔膜泵或小型渦卷泵做前級。零流量壓縮比 K₀ 決定每種氣體從前級回流到入口的分壓，入口極限壓力是各氣體 p_fore,i/K₀,i 的總和再加上出氣量除以抽速；重氣體的 K₀ 高達 10¹¹，前級成分只對氫與氦重要。高氣體流量時轉子被氣體摩擦加熱，馬達功率與轉子溫度上限（鋁合金潛變）決定了泵的最大流量與最大前級壓力。~Turbo stages work only in molecular flow; above roughly 10⁻² mbar at the inlet, intermolecular collisions between the blades destroy the compression, so a turbopump always needs a backing pump. Hybrid pumps add Holweck spiral-groove drag stages behind the turbo stages, raising the permitted foreline pressure to several millibar so that a diaphragm pump or a small scroll pump can serve as backing. The zero-flow compression ratio K₀ sets the partial pressure of each gas that leaks back from foreline to inlet, and the inlet ultimate pressure is the sum of p_fore,i/K₀,i over the gases plus outgassing divided by pumping speed; for heavy gases K₀ reaches 10¹¹, so the foreline composition matters only for hydrogen and helium. At high throughput gas friction heats the rotor, and the motor power together with the rotor temperature limit (creep of the aluminium alloy) fixes the pump's maximum throughput and maximum foreline pressure.
units.model: 入口極限壓力 p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S。前級總壓 5×10⁻² mbar（渦卷泵），其中氫分壓 1×10⁻⁴ mbar（教學假設）。氮：5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar，可忽略。氫：混合泵 K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ 時為 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar；舊式純渦輪泵 K₀(H₂) = 10³ 時為 1×10⁻⁷ mbar。若腔體氫出氣 Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s、S = 260 L/s，出氣項為 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar，比氫回流項小得多，所以這台泵站的下限由前級氫分壓與 K₀(H₂) 決定，而不是由泵的抽速決定。~Inlet ultimate pressure p_ult ≈ Σ p_fore,i/K₀,i + Q/S. Foreline total 5×10⁻² mbar from a scroll pump, with a hydrogen partial pressure of 1×10⁻⁴ mbar (teaching assumption). Nitrogen: 5×10⁻²/10¹¹ = 5×10⁻¹³ mbar, negligible. Hydrogen: with a hybrid pump of K₀(H₂) = 10⁵ it is 10⁻⁴/10⁵ = 1×10⁻⁹ mbar; with an older pure turbo pump of K₀(H₂) = 10³ it is 1×10⁻⁷ mbar. If chamber hydrogen outgassing is Q = 2×10⁻⁹ mbar·L/s and S = 260 L/s, the outgassing term is 7.7×10⁻¹² mbar, far below the hydrogen backflow term, so this station's floor is set by foreline hydrogen and K₀(H₂), not by the pump's speed.
units.verify: 量 K₀：封住入口，從前級以針閥注入測試氣體到數個壓力點，記錄前級壓力與入口壓力，斜率的倒數就是 K₀，氮與氫各做一次；在實際氣體負載下記錄前級壓力並確認低於額定上限；高流量時監看控制器回報的轉子溫度與馬達電流，並確認泵在額定最大流量下仍保持全速。~Measure K₀: blank the inlet, admit test gas into the foreline through a needle valve at several pressure points, log foreline and inlet pressures, and the inverse slope is K₀, once for nitrogen and once for hydrogen; under the real gas load log the foreline pressure and confirm it stays below the rated limit; at high throughput watch the rotor temperature and motor current reported by the controller and confirm the pump holds full speed at its rated maximum throughput.
units.failure: 前級管路有空氣洩漏或前級泵老化，前級壓力爬過容許上限：壓縮比崩潰、入口壓力跳升數個數量級，轉子因氣體摩擦發熱而由溫度保護停機；若前級是油封旋片泵，油蒸氣還會在這段期間回流進腔體，留下碳氫污染。~An air leak in the foreline or an ageing backing pump pushes the foreline pressure past its permitted limit: the compression collapses, the inlet pressure jumps by orders of magnitude, and the rotor, heated by gas friction, is stopped by its temperature protection; with an oil-sealed rotary-vane backing pump, oil vapour also backstreams into the chamber during this interval and leaves hydrocarbon contamination.
units.misconception: 前級壓力只要低於 1 mbar，對渦輪泵入口壓力就沒有影響。~As long as the foreline stays below 1 mbar it has no effect on the inlet pressure.

units.anchor: 鋁合金轉子與軸承~Aluminium-alloy rotor and bearings
units.title: 轉子材料、動平衡與軸承~Rotor materials, balancing and bearings
units.mechanism: 轉子由單塊高強度鋁合金整體切削，葉尖速度 300–500 m/s 使離心應力逼近材料極限，所以轉子溫度上限（約 90–120 °C）是為了控制鋁合金的潛變而設。轉子必須做到極高等級的動平衡，否則不平衡力隨 ω² 放大成振動與軸承負載。軸承有兩種：混合軸承在前級側用陶瓷球加鋼製滾道、終身潤滑油脂，在高真空側用永磁軸承；五軸主動磁浮則完全沒有潤滑劑與微粒、振動更低，但需要備用的機械落地軸承承受斷電或撞機。葉片的製造公差、表面處理與入口防護網都屬於轉子工程的一部分。~The rotor is machined from a single block of high-strength aluminium alloy, and tip speeds of 300–500 m/s push the centrifugal stress toward the material limit, which is why the rotor temperature ceiling of about 90–120 °C exists: it bounds the creep of the alloy. The rotor must be balanced to an extremely fine grade, because any residual unbalance is amplified by ω² into vibration and bearing load. Two bearing systems are used: hybrid bearings with ceramic balls on steel races and lifetime grease on the foreline side plus a permanent-magnet bearing on the high-vacuum side, or five-axis active magnetic levitation with no lubricant and no particles and lower vibration, which needs backup touchdown bearings for power loss or a crash. Blade machining tolerances, surface treatment and the inlet protection screen are all part of rotor engineering.
units.model: 實心圓盤的最大離心應力 σ ≈ 0.41·ρ·v_tip²（ν = 0.3）：鋁合金 ρ = 2700 kg/m³、v_tip = 471 m/s，σ ≈ 0.41×2700×471² ≈ 2.5×10⁸ Pa = 250 MPa，對降伏強度約 500 MPa 的 7000 系鋁合金安全係數約 2。平衡等級 G 0.4 代表 e·ω = 0.4 mm/s：ω = 2π×1500 ≈ 9425 rad/s，重心偏心 e = 0.4/9425 mm ≈ 4.2×10⁻⁵ mm = 42 nm。轉子動能 E = ½·I·ω²，取 I = 1.6×10⁻³ kg·m²，E ≈ 0.5×1.6×10⁻³×9425² ≈ 71 kJ，撞機時這些能量在毫秒內釋放成法蘭上的扭矩，所以安裝螺栓數與法蘭等級必須依廠商規定。~The peak centrifugal stress of a solid disc is σ ≈ 0.41·ρ·v_tip² (ν = 0.3): for aluminium alloy ρ = 2700 kg/m³ and v_tip = 471 m/s, σ ≈ 0.41×2700×471² ≈ 2.5×10⁸ Pa = 250 MPa, a safety factor of about 2 against the roughly 500 MPa yield of a 7000-series alloy. Balance grade G 0.4 means e·ω = 0.4 mm/s: with ω = 2π×1500 ≈ 9425 rad/s the centre-of-mass eccentricity is e = 0.4/9425 mm ≈ 4.2×10⁻⁵ mm = 42 nm. The rotor's kinetic energy E = ½·I·ω² with I = 1.6×10⁻³ kg·m² is E ≈ 0.5×1.6×10⁻³×9425² ≈ 71 kJ, released within milliseconds as torque on the flange in a crash, which is why bolt count and flange rating must follow the vendor's mounting rules.
units.verify: 在泵的法蘭上用加速規量振動頻譜：基頻在轉速頻率（90,000 rpm 即 1500 Hz）及其諧波，軸承缺陷頻率另有特徵線；每季記錄振幅趨勢，上升代表軸承磨耗或不平衡變化。記錄升速與自然減速時間、軸承溫度；磁浮泵則監看位置感測器的軌跡振幅。把這些數值和廠商驗收值比較，超過即安排軸承保養。~Measure the vibration spectrum on the pump flange with an accelerometer: the fundamental sits at the rotation frequency (90,000 rpm is 1500 Hz) with its harmonics, and bearing-defect frequencies show up as separate lines; log the amplitude trend quarterly, and a rise indicates bearing wear or a change in balance. Record run-up and free run-down times and bearing temperature; on a magnetically levitated pump watch the orbit amplitude from the position sensors. Compare these with the vendor's acceptance values and schedule bearing service when exceeded.
units.failure: 一顆螺絲掉進入口，或空氣在全速時從入口灌入：轉子撞機，葉片剪斷、71 kJ 動能在毫秒內變成扭矩；若泵只用了幾顆螺栓固定、沒有依規定安裝，泵會從法蘭上扭脫並損壞腔體；後果是泵報廢、腔體檢修，所以入口網與受控通氣閥不是選配。~A screw dropped into the inlet, or air rushing in through the inlet at full speed, crashes the rotor: blades shear and 71 kJ of kinetic energy becomes torque within milliseconds; if the pump was held by only a few bolts outside the vendor's mounting rules it twists off the flange and damages the chamber; the consequence is a scrapped pump and a chamber overhaul, which is why the inlet screen and the controlled vent valve are not optional.
units.misconception: 渦輪泵只是個轉得快的風扇，撞機頂多換一台泵。~A turbopump is just a fast fan, and a crash at worst means replacing the pump.

units.anchor: 電容薄膜、Pirani 與離子計感測元件~CDG, Pirani and ionisation sensing elements
units.title: 三種真空計物理與量程覆蓋~Three gauge physics and range coverage
units.mechanism: 沒有任何一種真空計能從 1000 mbar 量到 10⁻¹² mbar，所以泵站要用三種物理機制接力：電容薄膜計直接量氣體對薄膜的力，與氣體種類無關，每個感測頭涵蓋約四個數量級，精度可達 0.2%；Pirani 計量加熱絲的熱損失，在 10⁻⁴ 到 10 mbar 之間熱損失與壓力有關，但隨氣體的熱傳導係數不同而讀值不同，接近大氣時熱傳導不再隨壓力變化而飽和；游離計分成冷陰極的 Penning／反磁控管（放電電流約隨 p^n 變化，n 約 1.1–1.4，耐用但點火有延遲）與熱陰極的 Bayard–Alpert（10⁻² 到 10⁻¹¹ mbar，引出式到 10⁻¹²）。組合計把 Pirani 與游離計做在一起自動切換。~No single gauge spans 1000 mbar to 10⁻¹² mbar, so a pumping station relays between three physical mechanisms: the capacitance-diaphragm gauge measures the gas force on a membrane directly, independent of gas species, each head covering about four decades with accuracy down to 0.2%; the Pirani gauge measures the heat loss of a heated wire, which depends on pressure between 10⁻⁴ and 10 mbar but reads differently for gases of different thermal conductivity and saturates toward atmosphere where conduction stops depending on pressure; ionisation gauges split into cold-cathode Penning or inverted-magnetron types (discharge current roughly ∝ p^n with n about 1.1–1.4, robust but slow to strike) and the hot-cathode Bayard–Alpert gauge (10⁻² to 10⁻¹¹ mbar, 10⁻¹² for the extractor type). Combination gauges package a Pirani with an ionisation element and switch automatically.
units.model: 電容薄膜計：C = ε₀·A/d，薄膜面積 A = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m²、間隙 d = 100 µm，C₀ = 8.85×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁴/10⁻⁴ = 8.85 pF；滿量程 1 mbar = 100 Pa 讓中心撓度 10 µm（設計值），ΔC/C ≈ 10%；要分辨滿量程的 10⁻⁴（即 10⁻⁴ mbar），電容分辨率需達 10⁻⁵ 相對值，約 0.1 fF，這就是薄膜計必須恆溫並做零點校正的原因。Penning 計 I = k·p^n：若實際 n = 1.2 而控制器假設 n = 1，跨三個數量級的誤差達 10^(0.2×3) ≈ 4 倍。~Capacitance-diaphragm gauge: C = ε₀·A/d with membrane area A = 1 cm² = 10⁻⁴ m² and gap d = 100 µm gives C₀ = 8.85×10⁻¹²×10⁻⁴/10⁻⁴ = 8.85 pF; a full-scale 1 mbar = 100 Pa deflects the centre by 10 µm (design value), so ΔC/C ≈ 10%; resolving 10⁻⁴ of full scale (10⁻⁴ mbar) demands a relative capacitance resolution of 10⁻⁵, about 0.1 fF, which is why the head is thermostated and zeroed. Penning gauge I = k·p^n: if the true n = 1.2 while the controller assumes n = 1, the error across three decades reaches 10^(0.2×3) ≈ 4 times.
units.verify: 抽氣過程中把各真空計在重疊量程內互相核對：10⁻³ 到 1 mbar 比較薄膜計與 Pirani（對氬、氦要套用 Pirani 的氣體係數），10⁻⁴ 到 10⁻³ mbar 比較 Pirani 與 Penning 或 BA 計；Penning 比其他計晚幾秒點火是正常的；把所有讀值對時間作圖，重疊區內偏差超過 30% 的真空計送校正。~During pump-down cross-check the gauges in their overlapping ranges: compare the diaphragm gauge with the Pirani between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar (applying the Pirani gas factors for argon or helium), and the Pirani with the Penning or BA gauge between 10⁻⁴ and 10⁻³ mbar; a Penning striking a few seconds after the others is normal; plot every reading against time, and send any gauge that deviates more than 30% in an overlap for calibration.
units.failure: 用 Pirani 判斷何時啟動渦輪泵，但腔內是富氦氣體：Pirani 顯示 10⁻² mbar、實際是 10⁻¹ mbar，渦輪泵在過高壓力下升速、轉子過熱跳機；另一種是薄膜計感測頭在溫度變化後零點漂移，所有低端讀值帶著固定偏移，製程壓力因而設錯。~A Pirani used to decide when to start the turbopump while the chamber holds helium-rich gas: the Pirani shows 10⁻² mbar but the real pressure is 10⁻¹ mbar, the turbopump runs up at too high a pressure and trips on rotor temperature; another case is a diaphragm head whose zero drifts after a temperature change, so every low-range reading carries a fixed offset and the process pressure is set wrongly.
units.misconception: Pirani 計的讀值與氣體種類無關。~A Pirani reading does not depend on the gas species.

units.anchor: 校正腔與旋轉轉子參考計~Calibration chamber and spinning-rotor reference
units.title: 真空計校正與不確定度鏈~Gauge calibration and the uncertainty chain
units.mechanism: 真空量值的溯源鏈從國家計量機構的初級標準開始：靜態膨脹法涵蓋約 10⁻⁴ 到 1000 mbar，孔口流動（動態膨脹）法涵蓋約 10⁻⁸ 到 10⁻² mbar；轉移標準是旋轉轉子真空計（量鋼球在氣體中的減速率，約 10⁻⁶ 到 1 mbar，不確定度約 1%）與電容薄膜計；工作真空計則在校正腔內以比較法校正。主要不確定度來源包括參考計本身、氣體種類、熱蒸騰（真空計與腔體溫度不同時，分子流下 p₁/p₂ = √(T₁/T₂)）、真空計安裝位置的傳導率效應，以及熱陰極計靈敏度在兩次校正之間 10–20% 的漂移。~The traceability chain for vacuum starts at the primary standards of national metrology institutes: static expansion covers about 10⁻⁴ to 1000 mbar and orifice-flow (dynamic expansion) about 10⁻⁸ to 10⁻² mbar; transfer standards are the spinning-rotor gauge (measuring the deceleration of a levitated steel ball in gas, about 10⁻⁶ to 1 mbar with roughly 1% uncertainty) and the capacitance-diaphragm gauge; working gauges are then calibrated by comparison in a calibration chamber. The main uncertainty sources are the reference gauge itself, gas species, thermal transpiration (with gauge and chamber at different temperatures, p₁/p₂ = √(T₁/T₂) in molecular flow), conductance effects at the gauge's mounting position, and the 10–20% drift of hot-cathode sensitivity between calibrations.
units.model: 熱蒸騰：恆溫在 45 °C（318 K）的薄膜計接到 293 K 的腔體，分子流下 p_gauge/p_chamber = √(318/293) ≈ 1.042，讀值高 4.2%，在 10⁻³ mbar 以下必須修正。BA 計的不確定度預算：靈敏度漂移 ±15%、參考計 ±2%、氣體修正 ±5%、位置與傳導率 ±5%，均方根 √(15² + 2² + 5² + 5²) ≈ ±17%；若把控制器裡的靈敏度常數留在出廠值 25 mbar⁻¹ 而老化後實際是 18 mbar⁻¹，讀值系統性偏低 28%。~Thermal transpiration: a diaphragm gauge thermostated at 45 °C (318 K) on a chamber at 293 K reads p_gauge/p_chamber = √(318/293) ≈ 1.042 in molecular flow, 4.2% high, which must be corrected below 10⁻³ mbar. Uncertainty budget of a BA gauge: sensitivity drift ±15%, reference gauge ±2%, gas correction ±5%, position and conductance ±5%, root-sum-square √(15² + 2² + 5² + 5²) ≈ ±17%; leaving the controller's sensitivity constant at the factory 25 mbar⁻¹ when the aged gauge really has 18 mbar⁻¹ makes every reading 28% low.
units.verify: 在重疊量程內用旋轉轉子計校正：Pirani 與薄膜計在 10⁻³ 到 1 mbar，游離計在 10⁻⁶ 到 10⁻³ mbar，每個數量級至少取三點檢查線性；把 BA 計量得的靈敏度寫回控制器；記錄溫度與氣體種類；建立不確定度預算表，並規定重新校正週期（例如一年或更換燈絲後）。~Calibrate against the spinning-rotor gauge in the overlapping ranges: Pirani and diaphragm gauges between 10⁻³ and 1 mbar, ionisation gauges between 10⁻⁶ and 10⁻³ mbar, with at least three points per decade to check linearity; write the measured BA sensitivity back into the controller; record temperature and gas species; build the uncertainty budget table and fix the recalibration interval (for example one year or after a filament change).
units.failure: 控制器換新後靈敏度常數回到出廠值，老化的 BA 計讀值偏低三成：團隊相信腔體在 7×10⁻¹¹ mbar，實際是 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，驗收報告與後續實驗的壓力紀錄全都系統性錯誤，直到與參考計比對才發現。~After a controller swap the sensitivity constant reverts to the factory value and the aged BA gauge reads thirty percent low: the team believes the chamber is at 7×10⁻¹¹ mbar when it is really at 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, and the acceptance report and every later pressure log are systematically wrong until a comparison with a reference gauge exposes it.
units.misconception: 新真空計出廠就校正好了，裝上去的讀值就是絕對值。~A new gauge comes calibrated from the factory, so its installed reading is absolute.

units.anchor: 流量計與測試罩~Flow meter and test dome
units.title: 抽速、流量上限與氣體負載測試~Testing pumping speed, throughput limit and gas loads
units.mechanism: 廠商的抽速是在標準測試罩中量的：氣體經校正流量計注入、真空計裝在規定位置，S = Q/(p − p₀)。腔體得到的有效抽速一定比銘牌低，因為要串聯管路與閥門的傳導率。泵還有流量上限：高流量時黏滯摩擦加熱轉子，馬達電流與轉子溫度達到上限後泵會降速，所以製程氣體負載必須查泵的 S(p) 曲線與最大流量規格。氣體負載由製程進氣、出氣與漏氣構成，三者相加後除以有效抽速才是工作壓力，而真空計的擺放若直視泵口會因分子束流效應讀得偏低。~A vendor's pumping speed is measured in a standard test dome: gas is admitted through a calibrated flow meter, the gauge sits at a prescribed position, and S = Q/(p − p₀). The effective speed at the chamber is always below nameplate because line and valve conductances are in series. The pump also has a throughput limit: at high flow viscous friction heats the rotor, and once motor current and rotor temperature reach their limits the pump slows, so process gas loads must be checked against the pump's S(p) curve and its maximum-throughput rating. The gas load is the sum of process gas, outgassing and leaks, and that sum divided by the effective speed is the working pressure; a gauge that looks straight into the pump inlet reads low because of molecular beaming.
units.model: 流量計法：Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s，基礎壓力 p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar，穩態 p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar，S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s（氮）。經 DN100、30 cm 的管子（C ≈ 403 L/s）接到腔體：S_eff = 1/(1/287 + 1/403) ≈ 168 L/s。若泵的最大流量為 2 mbar·L/s（教學假設），對應的入口壓力為 2/287 ≈ 7×10⁻³ mbar，製程壓力若高於此值，泵會降速或過熱。~Flow-meter method: Q = 1×10⁻³ mbar·L/s, base pressure p₀ = 2×10⁻⁸ mbar, steady p = 3.5×10⁻⁶ mbar, so S = Q/(p − p₀) = 1×10⁻³/3.48×10⁻⁶ ≈ 287 L/s for nitrogen. Through a DN100 tube 30 cm long (C ≈ 403 L/s) to the chamber: S_eff = 1/(1/287 + 1/403) ≈ 168 L/s. If the pump's maximum throughput is 2 mbar·L/s (teaching assumption), the corresponding inlet pressure is 2/287 ≈ 7×10⁻³ mbar, and a process pressure above that slows or overheats the pump.
units.verify: 在腔體上重現測試罩方法：經針閥接入校正流量計，在兩個數量級內取五個流量點記錄壓力，線性擬合的斜率倒數就是有效抽速；真空計要裝在不直視泵口的位置；把結果與廠商的 S(p) 曲線比較；在最大流量下連續運轉一小時，記錄馬達功率與轉子溫度是否穩定在上限以內；流量計用什麼氣體，抽速就是對什麼氣體。~Reproduce the test-dome method on the chamber: admit gas through a calibrated flow meter and needle valve, log the pressure at five flow points over two decades, and the inverse slope of a linear fit is the effective speed; mount the gauge out of the pump's line of sight; compare with the vendor's S(p) curve; run one hour at maximum throughput and record whether motor power and rotor temperature settle below their limits; the speed measured is for the gas used in the flow meter.
units.failure: 真空計裝在正對泵口的短管上，分子束流讓它讀低，抽速被高估 30–50%；再把氬氣流量計量到的值當成氮的抽速，兩個錯誤疊在一起，製程壓力設計整整差一倍；泵長期在超過最大流量下運轉，轉子溫度逼近上限，幾個月後軸承油脂劣化而失效。~A gauge on a short stub facing the pump inlet reads low because of beaming, so the speed is overestimated by 30–50%; treating a value measured with an argon flow meter as the nitrogen speed stacks a second error, and the process pressure design is off by a factor of two; the pump then runs above its maximum throughput for months, the rotor near its temperature limit, until the bearing grease degrades and fails.
units.misconception: 泵銘牌上的抽速就是腔體得到的抽速。~The nameplate pumping speed is what the chamber actually receives.

units.anchor: 控制器、通氣閥與互鎖~Controller, vent valve and interlocks
units.title: 泵站整合：啟動順序、通氣與保護~Pump-station integration: start sequence, venting and protection
units.mechanism: 泵站的整合是一連串有條件的動作：先啟動前級泵，前級壓力低於渦輪泵允許的啟動壓力後才升速；升速需數分鐘，控制器監看轉速、電流與溫度；真空計在 10⁻³ mbar 附近由 Pirani 切換到游離計；渦輪泵轉速超過 90% 且腔體已經由旁路粗抽到 10⁻² mbar 以下，閘閥才允許開啟。停電時通氣閥在延遲後以乾燥氮氣通氣，讓轉子受控減速並阻止前級的油氣或微粒回流；通氣速率要受限，避免黏滯氣流對葉片造成衝擊。冷卻（風冷或水冷）、入口法蘭的烘烤溫度上限（約 120 °C）、外部磁場（渦電流加熱轉子）與振動去耦都要在整合時一併設定。~Integrating a pumping station is a chain of conditional actions: start the backing pump first and run the turbopump up only once the foreline is below its permitted start pressure; run-up takes minutes while the controller watches speed, current and temperature; gauges switch from Pirani to ionisation near 10⁻³ mbar; the gate valve may open only when the turbopump exceeds 90% speed and the chamber has been rough-pumped through a bypass below 10⁻² mbar. On a power failure the vent valve admits dry nitrogen after a delay so the rotor decelerates under control and no oil vapour or particles backstream from the foreline; the venting rate is throttled so that viscous inflow does not shock the blades. Cooling (air or water), the inlet-flange bake limit (about 120 °C), external magnetic fields (eddy-current heating of the rotor) and vibration decoupling are all settled during integration.
units.model: 升速時間：轉子動能 71 kJ，馬達淨加速功率 200 W，t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min，與常見的 2–8 分鐘相符。在基礎壓力下不通氣自然減速，只靠約 5 W 的軸承摩擦耗能，需要 71,000/5 ≈ 1.4×10⁴ s ≈ 4 小時；受控通氣可在約一分鐘內停機。閘閥風險：100 L 腔體在 1 mbar 時含 100 mbar·L 氣體，若最大流量 2 mbar·L/s，開閥瞬間相當於 50 秒的滿載衝擊，所以必須先旁路粗抽到 10⁻² mbar（只剩 1 mbar·L）再開閘閥。~Run-up time: rotor kinetic energy 71 kJ and a net accelerating motor power of 200 W give t ≈ 71,000/200 ≈ 355 s ≈ 6 min, consistent with the usual 2–8 minutes. Free run-down at base pressure without venting dissipates only about 5 W in bearing friction, taking 71,000/5 ≈ 1.4×10⁴ s ≈ 4 hours, whereas controlled venting stops the rotor in about a minute. Gate-valve risk: a 100 L chamber at 1 mbar holds 100 mbar·L of gas, and with a maximum throughput of 2 mbar·L/s opening the valve is a 50-second full-load shock, so the chamber must first be rough-pumped through the bypass to 10⁻² mbar (only 1 mbar·L) before the gate valve opens.
units.verify: 試運轉時記錄轉速、電流、溫度、前級壓力與入口壓力對時間的曲線：升速、開閘閥、烘烤各一段；做停電測試：切斷市電，確認通氣閥在設定延遲後開啟、轉子在規定時間內停止，事後用殘氣分析儀確認沒有碳氫回流；逐條測試互鎖邏輯，例如轉速未達 90% 時閘閥不得開啟、前級壓力過高時渦輪泵降速。~During commissioning log speed, current, temperature, foreline and inlet pressure against time through run-up, gate-valve opening and bakeout; perform a power-failure test by cutting the mains and confirming that the vent valve opens after the set delay and the rotor stops within the specified time, then check with the residual-gas analyser that no hydrocarbons backstreamed; test every interlock line by line, for example that the gate valve cannot open below 90% speed and that the turbopump derates when the foreline pressure is too high.
units.failure: 對一個還在 10 mbar 的腔體直接開閘閥：氣體灌入量是最大流量的上千倍，轉子急減速、馬達限流、溫度保護跳機，嚴重時轉子落到緊急軸承上，之後必須檢查軸承；或是停電時沒有通氣閥、前級又是油封泵，泵油回流進腔體，整個系統要重新清洗烘烤。~Opening the gate valve to a chamber still at 10 mbar floods the pump with a thousand times its maximum throughput: the rotor decelerates violently, the motor hits its current limit, the temperature protection trips, and in bad cases the rotor lands on the emergency bearings, which then need inspection; or a power failure with no vent valve and an oil-sealed backing pump lets pump oil backstream into the chamber, forcing a full re-clean and re-bake.
units.misconception: 渦輪泵只要在轉，任何腔體壓力下都可以開閘閥。~Once the turbopump is spinning the gate valve can be opened at any chamber pressure.

units.anchor: 泵站驗收報告與運轉紀錄~Pump-station acceptance report and run log
units.title: 驗收、維護週期與交接~Acceptance, maintenance intervals and handoff
units.mechanism: 泵站驗收包含：入口封盲板後 24 小時的基礎壓力、接上腔體後的極限壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、額定負載下的前級壓力、噪音、各真空計在重疊區的交叉核對表，以及互鎖與停電測試紀錄。維護週期依軸承型式而定：油脂潤滑的混合軸承依運轉時數定期更換，磁浮泵沒有軸承保養但要監看落地軸承次數；前級渦卷泵的尖端密封與隔膜泵的膜片有各自的壽命；BA 計燈絲與 Penning 計的放電污染也要排程處理。交接文件必須記錄泵的序號、累計時數、軸承保養日期、各真空計的校正日期與靈敏度常數、互鎖邏輯版本與備品清單。~Pump-station acceptance covers the base pressure after 24 hours with the inlet blanked, the ultimate pressure once connected to the chamber, run-up time, vibration spectrum, foreline pressure at rated load, noise, the cross-check table of every gauge in its overlaps, and the interlock and power-failure test records. Maintenance intervals depend on the bearing type: grease-lubricated hybrid bearings are replaced on running hours, magnetically levitated pumps need no bearing service but their touchdown count is monitored; scroll-pump tip seals and diaphragm-pump membranes have their own lives; BA filaments and Penning discharge contamination are scheduled as well. The handoff record must list pump serial numbers, accumulated hours, bearing service dates, every gauge's calibration date and sensitivity constant, the interlock logic version and the spares list.
units.model: 盲板基礎壓力驗收值的來源：泵自身入口側的內表面約 0.05 m² = 500 cm²，未烘烤 24 小時後出氣率約 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²)（教學假設），Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s，S = 300 L/s，p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar，所以驗收門檻訂為 < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar 合理。真空計重校正週期：BA 計靈敏度每年漂移約 −5%（教學假設），允許誤差 ±10%，兩年後達 −10%，因此校正週期訂為最長兩年。維護排程：混合軸承每 3 年或依廠商時數更換，渦卷泵尖端密封每年檢查。~Where the blank-flange acceptance value comes from: the pump's own inlet-side surface is about 0.05 m² = 500 cm², the unbaked outgassing rate after 24 hours about 1×10⁻¹⁰ mbar·L/(s·cm²) (teaching assumption), so Q = 5×10⁻⁸ mbar·L/s, S = 300 L/s and p = 1.7×10⁻¹⁰ mbar, which makes an acceptance threshold of < 5×10⁻¹⁰ mbar reasonable. Gauge recalibration interval: BA sensitivity drifts about −5% per year (teaching assumption) against a ±10% allowance, reaching −10% after two years, so the interval is set at two years maximum. Maintenance schedule: hybrid bearings every 3 years or per the vendor's hour count, scroll-pump tip seals inspected yearly.
units.verify: 依序執行驗收：盲板 24 小時基礎壓力、升速時間、振動頻譜、各真空計重疊區交叉核對、互鎖與停電測試；每一項填入驗收表並與限值比對；交接時把運轉時數計、保養紀錄、備用墊片與通氣用氮氣供應一併移交，並由接手工程師在表上簽署；之後每次保養與校正都追加紀錄。~Run the acceptance in order: 24-hour blank-flange base pressure, run-up time, vibration spectrum, gauge cross-checks in the overlaps, interlock and power-failure tests; enter every item in the acceptance table against its limit; at handoff transfer the hour counter, the service log, spare gaskets and the nitrogen supply for venting, with the receiving engineer signing the table; append a record for every later service and calibration.
units.failure: 沒有時數紀錄，混合軸承的油脂在數年後乾涸：振動緩慢上升、泵越跑越熱，最後在實驗進行中軸承卡死、轉子撞機；另一種是換了控制器卻沒重設真空計切換點，BA 計在 10⁻² mbar 就點亮燈絲，幾週內燒斷。~With no hour log the grease in a hybrid bearing dries out after years: vibration creeps up, the pump runs hotter, and finally the bearing seizes mid-experiment and the rotor crashes; another case is a replaced controller whose gauge switch point was never reset, so the BA filament lights at 10⁻² mbar and burns out within weeks.
units.misconception: 磁浮渦輪泵完全免維護，不需要任何監測。~A magnetically levitated turbopump is maintenance-free and needs no monitoring at all.

example: 泵站選型練習：一台 50 L 的分析腔（例如飛行時間質譜儀）有樣品進氣負載 Q = 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s，另加出氣 2×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s，目標工作壓力 1×10⁻⁶ mbar。所需有效抽速 S_eff = 1×10⁻⁴/1×10⁻⁶ = 100 L/s。泵接在 DN100、20 cm 的管上，C ≈ 12.1×1000/20 ≈ 605 L/s，所需泵抽速 1/S_pump = 1/100 − 1/605 ≈ 0.00835，S_pump ≈ 120 L/s；選一台 260 L/s 的 DN100 泵留餘裕：S_eff = 1/(1/260 + 1/605) ≈ 182 L/s，工作壓力 p ≈ 1.02×10⁻⁴/182 ≈ 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar，達標且有近兩倍餘裕。前級：流量 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s 在 1×10⁻² mbar 的前級壓力下只需 0.01 L/s 的前級抽速，小型隔膜泵綽綽有餘；氫回流 10⁻⁵/10⁵ = 10⁻¹⁰ mbar 可忽略。真空計：Pirani 在 10⁻³ mbar 切換到 BA 計，BA 計靈敏度 20 mbar⁻¹、發射 1 mA，在 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar 的離子電流為 20×10⁻³×5.6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.1×10⁻⁸ A = 11 nA，遠高於 X 光極限。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實機規格。~Pump-station sizing exercise: a 50 L analytical chamber (for example a time-of-flight mass spectrometer) has a sample-inlet load Q = 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s plus 2×10⁻⁶ mbar·L/s of outgassing and a target working pressure of 1×10⁻⁶ mbar. The required effective speed is S_eff = 1×10⁻⁴/1×10⁻⁶ = 100 L/s. With the pump on a DN100 tube 20 cm long, C ≈ 12.1×1000/20 ≈ 605 L/s, the required pump speed follows from 1/S_pump = 1/100 − 1/605 ≈ 0.00835, S_pump ≈ 120 L/s; choosing a 260 L/s DN100 pump for margin gives S_eff = 1/(1/260 + 1/605) ≈ 182 L/s and a working pressure p ≈ 1.02×10⁻⁴/182 ≈ 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar, meeting the target with nearly a factor of two in hand. Backing: a throughput of 1×10⁻⁴ mbar·L/s at a foreline pressure of 1×10⁻² mbar needs only 0.01 L/s of backing speed, so a small diaphragm pump is ample, and the hydrogen backflow 10⁻⁵/10⁵ = 10⁻¹⁰ mbar is negligible. Gauges: the Pirani hands over to the BA gauge at 10⁻³ mbar, and with a sensitivity of 20 mbar⁻¹ and 1 mA emission the ion current at 5.6×10⁻⁷ mbar is 20×10⁻³×5.6×10⁻⁷ ≈ 1.1×10⁻⁸ A = 11 nA, far above the X-ray limit. Values are teaching assumptions, not any product's specification.
history: 1906 年 Pirani 提出熱傳導真空計，1913 年 Gaede 做出分子拖曳泵，1923 年 Holweck 加上螺旋槽結構；1937 年 Penning 發明冷陰極游離計，1950 年 Bayard 與 Alpert 的細絲收集極把量測下限推到 10⁻⁸ Torr 以下。1958 年 Becker 在 Arthur Pfeiffer 公司發明軸向葉片的渦輪分子泵，之後陶瓷球混合軸承與主動磁浮軸承相繼普及，混合 Holweck 段讓隔膜泵也能做前級。今天渦輪泵與真空計的組合是分析儀器、半導體製程、加速器與研究腔體的標準抽氣與量測方案。~Pirani proposed the thermal-conductivity gauge in 1906, Gaede built the molecular drag pump in 1913 and Holweck added the spiral-groove geometry in 1923; Penning invented the cold-cathode ionisation gauge in 1937, and in 1950 the thin-wire collector of Bayard and Alpert pushed the measurement floor below 10⁻⁸ Torr. In 1958 Becker at Arthur Pfeiffer invented the axial-bladed turbomolecular pump, ceramic-ball hybrid bearings and active magnetic levitation followed, and hybrid Holweck stages allowed diaphragm pumps to serve as backing. Today the combination of turbopumps and gauges is the standard pumping and measurement solution for analytical instruments, semiconductor processing, accelerators and research chambers.

sources.title: Pfeiffer Vacuum：高真空與超高真空用渦輪泵
sources.titleEn: Pfeiffer Vacuum: Turbopumps for high and ultra-high vacuum
sources.scope: 公開的渦輪泵產品說明：最高約 90,000 rpm、抽速 10 到 3000 L/s 以上、混合軸承與磁浮軸承的差異與雷射動平衡；不含設計圖。
sources.scopeEn: Public turbopump product description: up to about 90,000 rpm, pumping speeds from 10 to over 3,000 L/s, hybrid versus magnetic bearings and laser balancing; no design drawings.

sources.title: Leybold 真空基礎：渦輪分子泵如何運作
sources.titleEn: Leybold vacuum fundamentals: How does a turbomolecular pump work
sources.scope: 轉子周速與分子熱速度的關係、壓縮比隨分子量的變化（例如 k₀(N₂) ≈ 2×10⁸）、軸承型式與前級要求的公開教材。
sources.scopeEn: Public teaching text on rotor rim speed versus molecular thermal speed, compression ratio versus molecular mass (for example k₀(N₂) ≈ 2×10⁸), bearing types and backing requirements.

sources.title: Leybold IONIVAC：熱陰極游離真空計
sources.scope: Bayard–Alpert 計與引出式真空計的公開量程（約 2×10⁻¹¹ 到 10⁻² mbar、2×10⁻¹² 到 10⁻⁴ mbar）、雙燈絲與 Pirani 組合計的說明。
sources.scopeEn: Public ranges of Bayard–Alpert and extractor gauges (about 2×10⁻¹¹ to 10⁻² mbar and 2×10⁻¹² to 10⁻⁴ mbar), dual filaments and Pirani combination gauges.

sources.title: Agilent：真空量測產品

sources.scopeEn: Public product classification of active gauges, controllers and transducers covering Pirani, diaphragm, cold-cathode and hot-cathode gauges.
